values.en: For an arc-length parametrized space curve $\gamma$, the **vector curvature** (curvature vector) is $\boldsymbol{\kappa}_{\gamma}:=\frac{d\boldsymbol{t}}{ds}$, i.e. $\boldsymbol{\kappa}_{\gamma}(s)=\boldsymbol{t}_{\gamma}'(s)$; on an arc-length parametrization this is $\gamma''(s)$. For a regular curve in a general parameter $t$ the same object is $\boldsymbol{t}_{\gamma}'(t)/\lVert\gamma'(t)\rVert$. It is the arc-length derivative of the **unit** tangent, so it is not the acceleration: velocity $\gamma'$ and acceleration $\gamma''$ are different objects and coincide with the tangent and the curvature vector only for an arc-length parametrization. The principal normal $\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$ is defined only where $\boldsymbol{\kappa}_{\gamma}\neq 0$.
values.zh-CN: 对以弧长为参数的空间曲线 $\gamma$，**向量曲率**（曲率向量）定义为 $\boldsymbol{\kappa}_{\gamma}:=\frac{d\boldsymbol{t}}{ds}$，即 $\boldsymbol{\kappa}_{\gamma}(s)=\boldsymbol{t}_{\gamma}'(s)$；在弧长参数下它就是 $\gamma''(s)$。对一般参数 $t$ 下的正则曲线，同一对象是 $\boldsymbol{t}_{\gamma}'(t)/\lVert\gamma'(t)\rVert$。它是**单位**切向量对弧长的导数，因此不是加速度：速度 $\gamma'$ 与加速度 $\gamma''$ 是不同的对象，只有在弧长参数下才分别等于切向量与向量曲率。主法向量 $\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$ 只在 $\boldsymbol{\kappa}_{\gamma}\neq 0$ 处定义。
